<html lang="ja"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, minimum-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no" name="viewport"/>
<title>高級ホテル・高級旅館の予約ならRelux（リラックス）</title>
<meta content="telephone=no" name="format-detection"/>
<style>
    div.page {
      padding: 30px 20px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    div.page h1 {
      margin-bottom: 30px;
    }

    div.page h1 img {
      width: 120px;
    }

    h2 {
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 20px;
      margin: 0 0 10px;
    }

    p.txt {
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 2.0;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      color: #333333;
    }

    p.txt-small {
      font-size: 11px!important;
    }

    p.time {
      font-size: 14px!important;
    }

    div.box {
      border: 1px solid #DDDDDD;
      padding: 20px 10px 10px;
      margin:  30px 0;
    }

    p.copyright {
      margin-top: 30px;
      font-size: 11px!important;
      border-top: 1px solid #DDDDDD;
      padding-top: 20px;
    }

    @media(min-width:768px) {
      div.page {
        padding: 60px 0px;
        width: 768px;
        margin: 0 auto;
      }

      div.page h1 {
        margin-bottom: 60px;
      }

      div.page h1 img {
        width: 220px;
      }

      p.txt {
        font-size: 13px;
      }

      p.time {
        font-size: 16px!important;
      }

      p.copyright {
        margin-top: 60px;
      }
    }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="page">
<h1><img alt="Relux" src="data:image/png;base64,"/></h1>
<p class="txt txt-c">Relux is currently under maintenance. We will be back soon.<br/>We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.<br/>Thank you for your support to Relux all the time.</p>
<p class="txt">On a separate topic, in order to fully comply with GDPR, <br/>Relux does not support access from European Union region at the moment.</p>
<p class="copyright">Loco Partners Inc.</p>
</div><!--page-->
<script>
        // Get Browser language
        var lang = (navigator.language) ? navigator.language : navigator.userLanguage;
        // In case of undefind language is ja
        if(lang === undefined)
            lang = "ja"; 
   
        if(lang.toLowerCase().indexOf("ja") !== -1){
            // In case of Japanese
        }
         else{
            // In case of not Japanese
            var txtcClass = document.getElementsByClassName("txt-c");
            txtcClass[0].innerHTML = "Relux is currently under maintenance. We will be back soon.<br>We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.<br>Thank you for your support to Relux all the time.";
            var txtClass = document.getElementsByClassName("txt");
            txtClass[1].innerHTML = "On a separate topic, in order to fully comply with GDPR, <br>Relux does not support access from European Union region at the moment.";
            var crClass = document.getElementsByClassName("copyright");
            crClass[0].innerHTML = "Loco Partners Inc.";
        }
    </script>
</body></html>
